spec_findings.issue: Structural granularity is incomplete relative to the Layer 1 plan.
spec_findings.detail: The 82 structural blocks faithfully mirror Layer 0 blocks, but some Layer 0 blocks contain additional explicit manuscript objects that are not yet promoted to their own Layer 1 structural units.
examples: The Troy Sentinel article dated Friday, August 3, 1827 is embedded inside the same Layer 0 block as the trial verdict.
The Reminiscences/Cherry Hill section contains a 1775 letter, a 1789 advertisement, and an 1815 hotel advertisement.
Witnesses are indexed only as call markers; full testimony spans and legal ruling/argument units are not yet structurally segmented.

spec_findings.issue: The Source Registry currently conflates source identity, source type, attribution metadata, front-matter credits, and bibliography entries.
spec_findings.detail: All stored line ranges are exact, but several source records use the first attribution line as the source identity even when that line is actually a contextual heading, document type, agency, or recipient.
examples: "Colonial Days And Ways" is currently the primary source label for a header that also explicitly names "The Strang Family Genealogy" and "Josephine Frost, 1915."

"Broadside" is currently used as a primary source label even though it functions as a document type and the manuscript separately names The Pictorial Life and Adventures of Mrs. Whipple & Jesse Strang, 1848.
"Albany County Sheriff" is currently treated as the source identity for The Voluntary Examination Of Elsie Whipple, although it is better preserved as institutional attribution metadata.
"Sent to his daughter Margaret Elizabeth Butler" is currently treated as a source identity, although it is recipient metadata for The Testimony of Robert Wynkoop Lansing.

spec_findings.issue: Some explicit embedded documents are not represented in the Source Registry.
examples: The Last Will and Testament of Philip Van Rensselaer.
Farewell Address / The final words of Jesse James Strang.

spec_findings.issue: Trial-day blocks do not yet carry inherited source context.
spec_findings.detail: The trial source headers are captured, but subsequent dated trial-day blocks often have empty source_ids. Layer 1 needs to distinguish direct source attribution from source context inherited through manuscript structure.

spec_findings.issue: Current validation proves address correctness, not semantic classification correctness.
spec_findings.detail: The existing validation correctly proves that every stored range points to the exact Layer 0 text, but it cannot prove that a line was classified as the right kind of structural or source object.

required_before_seal: Promote explicit nested manuscript objects into hierarchical structural units while keeping the 82 Layer 0 blocks as immutable containers.

Add parent/child relationships and structural types for newspaper items, trial days, testimony units, legal arguments/rulings, advertisements, poems, embedded documents, images, appendix material, and other explicit forms.

Rebuild the Source Registry with separate fields for source title as written, source type, author as written, date as written, publication as written, institutional attribution, recipient, and source-occurrence role.
Separate direct attribution, inherited source context, front-matter source credits, archive acknowledgments, and bibliography entries.
Add explicit source/document records for the Philip Van Rensselaer will, Robert Wynkoop Lansing testimony, Farewell Address, and other embedded documents that are themselves presented as documents.
Run a reverse structural audit against Layer 0 so every explicit manuscript object expected by the Layer 1 specification is accounted for before Layer 1 is sealed.
